critical_code_review_comments: app/(partner)/index.tsx is ~487 lines and rapidly approaching the >700 line guideline; consider extracting Greeting / EarningsHero / StatsGrid / AcceptStreak / AlertCheck into sub-components before it grows further.
8 parallel useQuery hooks fire on every mount without staleTime; consider adding staleTime to reduce refetch churn on tab switches.
